summary: Admin Portal Gaps Implementation: 4-phase plan covering Security/GDPR fixes (VUL-001-007), Schema migration (deletedAt, indexes), CRUD implementation (edit/delete appointment types, rejection dialog, audit filters), and UX (dark mode, mobile menu). Total effort: 35.5h across 22 subtasks.

phases.name: Security & GDPR Compliance
phases.description: Fix critical security vulnerabilities (VUL-001 to VUL-007). Adds audit logging to employer verify/reject, appointment type CRUD, fixes processedBy vulnerability, adds input validation.

subtasks.description: Fix VUL-004: Remove processedBy from args in gdpr.processErasure, use authenticated admin from requireAdmin() context instead. Add audit logging for erasure_processed action.
acceptanceCriteria: processedBy arg removed from mutation args
processedBy field populated from admin.email via requireAdmin()

subtasks.description: Fix VUL-001: Add audit logging to employers.verify mutation. Call internal.gdpr.logAction with employer_verified action after patch.
acceptanceCriteria: Action logged as employer_verified with companyName in details

subtasks.description: Fix VUL-001 part 2: Add audit logging to employers.reject mutation. Add VUL-007 fix: Require rejection reason (min 10 chars).
acceptanceCriteria: Validation throws ConvexError if reason < 10 chars
Rejection reason included in audit details

subtasks.description: Fix VUL-002: Add audit logging to appointmentTypes.create and update mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: update logs appointment_type_updated action with changed fields

subtasks.description: Fix VUL-005/VUL-006: Add input validation to appointmentTypes.create - name length (1-100), description length, duration (15-480 min), price (0-99999).
acceptanceCriteria: Same validation applied to update mutation

phases.gateCondition: All 5 security tasks complete with passing typecheck. Run: npm run typecheck

phases.name: Database Schema Migration
phases.description: Add deletedAt field to appointmentTypes table for soft delete support. Add by_deleted index. Add by_appointment_type index to appointments for FK integrity checks.

subtasks.description: Add deletedAt optional field to appointmentTypes table schema. Add by_deleted index.
Add by_appointment_type index to appointments table for FK integrity check during delete.
acceptanceCriteria: by_appointment_type index added to appointments table
npx convex dev shows schema pushed successfully

subtasks.description: Push schema changes to Convex and verify migration completes.
acceptanceCriteria: npx convex dev completes without errors
Schema changes visible in Convex dashboard

phases.gateCondition: Schema deployed successfully. Verify with: npx tsx CONVEX-CLI/SCRIPTS/convex-tables.ts --json

phases.name: CRUD Implementation
phases.description: Implement missing CRUD operations: appointment type remove mutation with soft/hard delete, listAll with includeDeleted param, custom rejection reason dialog, audit log filter UI.

subtasks.description: Add appointmentTypes.remove mutation with soft/hard delete logic. Check FK integrity via by_appointment_type index - soft delete if in use, hard delete if safe.
acceptanceCriteria: remove mutation exported with typeId arg
Soft delete (set deletedAt, isActive=false) if used
Audit logs both soft and hard deletes
Returns { softDeleted: true, reason: string } or { deleted: true }

subtasks.description: Update appointmentTypes.listAll query to accept includeDeleted param. Filter out soft-deleted by default.
acceptanceCriteria: includeDeleted arg added as optional boolean
Default behavior filters where deletedAt === undefined

subtasks.description: Extend gdpr.getAuditLogs query with filter params: action, actorType, resourceType, startTime, endTime.
acceptanceCriteria: All 5 filter params added as optional args

subtasks.description: Add Edit/Delete UI to AppointmentTypes.tsx. Edit button opens pre-populated dialog. Delete button shows AlertDialog confirmation. Wire to update and remove mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit button on each type card opens dialog in edit mode
Dialog title changes to Edit Appointment Type
AlertDialog explains soft vs hard delete behavior
UI updates in real-time after mutations

subtasks.description: Add custom rejection reason dialog to EmployerVerification.tsx. Reject button opens Dialog with Textarea (min 10 chars). Pass reason to reject mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: Reject button opens Dialog instead of direct mutation
Textarea for rejection reason (min 10 chars validation)

subtasks.description: Add filter UI to AuditLogs.tsx. Implement 5 filter dropdowns (action, actorType, resourceType, startDate, endDate). Wire to getAuditLogs query params.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter card with 5 inputs (3 Selects, 2 date inputs)
Action type dropdown with 12 predefined actions
Actor type dropdown (employer, doctor, admin, system)
Resource type dropdown (patient, appointment, report, consent, employer)

phases.gateCondition: All backend mutations tested via Convex CLI. Frontend compiles. Run: npm run typecheck && npm run build

phases.name: UX Implementation
phases.description: Implement dark mode toggle (useTheme hook + ThemeToggle component) and mobile hamburger menu (Sheet-based slide-out nav). Both integrate into AdminLayout header.

subtasks.description: Create useTheme hook in src/hooks/useTheme.ts. Support light/dark/system modes. Persist to localStorage. Listen for system preference changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Export useTheme() hook returning { theme, setTheme }
Theme type: light or dark or system
Listens for prefers-color-scheme media query changes
Works with existing CSS variables in index.css

subtasks.description: Create ThemeToggle component in src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx. Dropdown menu with Light/Dark/System options. Use Sun/Moon/Monitor icons.
acceptanceCriteria: DropdownMenu with ghost variant button trigger
Sun icon visible in light mode, Moon in dark (animated transition)
Three menu items: Light, Dark, System

subtasks.description: Add mobile hamburger menu to AdminLayout.tsx using Sheet component. Hamburger visible on mobile (<768px), desktop nav hidden. 44px touch targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop nav hidden on mobile (md:flex hidden)
Sheet slides from right with nav links

subtasks.description: Integrate ThemeToggle into AdminLayout header. Add to both desktop nav and mobile header (before hamburger).
acceptanceCriteria: Positioned before Sign Out in desktop nav
Positioned before hamburger in mobile header

phases.gateCondition: Visual verification via Browser-CLI. Dark mode toggles correctly. Mobile menu opens and navigates.

phases.name: Browser Testing & Validation
phases.description: Execute Browser-CLI manual tests for all new features. Collect evidence. Update NAV-MAP.md with new selectors.

subtasks.description: Test appointment types Edit/Delete flow via Browser-CLI. Verify soft delete for types with appointments, hard delete for unused types.
acceptanceCriteria: Soft delete message shown for types in use
Hard delete removes type from list

subtasks.description: Test custom rejection reason dialog via Browser-CLI. Verify min length validation, reason appears in mutation payload.
Test audit log filters via Browser-CLI. Apply each filter type, verify results update correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Action filter reduces results to matching action

subtasks.description: Test dark mode toggle via Browser-CLI. Verify theme persists, all pages render correctly in dark mode.
acceptanceCriteria: All cards have correct dark backgrounds

subtasks.description: Test mobile hamburger menu via Browser-CLI. Resize to mobile, verify menu opens/closes, navigation works.

phases.gateCondition: All browser tests pass. Screenshots collected as evidence.

risks.description: Schema migration may require Convex redeploy
risks.mitigation: Run npx convex dev after schema changes

risks.description: Soft delete logic complexity for FK integrity
risks.mitigation: Query by_appointment_type index to check usage before delete

risks.description: UI components may need Radix primitives not yet installed
Mobile responsiveness may need iterative testing
risks.mitigation: Use Browser-CLI resize command to test at 375px width
